keyVerseDR: "So shall the last be first and the first last." (Mt 20:16)

level1.title: God Is Generous
level1.story: A landowner hired workers for his vineyard. Some came early and some came late. He paid them all the same, because he was generous!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did the late workers get?
level1.prayer: God, thank You for being so good. Amen.

activity.title: Count the workers
activity.intro: Tally how many times you hear these words at Mass.

level2.title: Workers in the Vineyard
level2.story: Jesus said the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out at dawn to hire workers for his vineyard. He went out again at nine, at noon, at three, and at five o'clock and hired more. In the evening, he paid everyone a full day's wage, starting with the last. Those who came first grumbled, but he said, "Am I not free to be generous?" Jesus said, "So the last shall be first, and the first last."
level2.keyLine: So shall the last be first and the first last.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did the first workers complain?
How is God's love a gift?
level2.prayer: Lord, keep me from envy and make me generous. Amen.

activity.title: Who was hired when?
activity.intro: Match the time to the story.
pairs: First workers agree to a day's pay
More workers stand idle in the market
